column1: # lib/config/modules.tsv -- the ONE module table.
# Read by install.sh and lib/adopt.sh through lib/config/modules.sh; neither keeps a private
# copy. Add a module, move a hook, or flip a default HERE and nowhere else
# (tests/test-modules-table.sh pins every other surface to this file).
# Columns, tab separated; '#' starts a comment line; '-' means none:
#   module   the --with name and the [modules] key in kit.toml / .kit.toml
#   default  core    on in a FRESH install and a fresh adopt (a per-project .kit.toml may turn it off)
#            opt-in  off until named in --with or set true in [modules]
#   hooks    space separated <Event>:<script> pairs the module wires. The Event must match where
#            settings.json registers the script; statusLine is the one non-hook entry (the
#            statusline.sh command). Several events for one script are several pairs.
#   clis     space separated bin/<name> entrypoints exposed on PATH (~/.local/bin)
# 'spine' is not a toggle: install.sh wires it on every install, so it is never a valid --with
# name and never a [modules] key. It stays here so the safety hooks have one home too.
# Existing installs keep what they have: a default change reaches a NEW install only.
# intake-sweep belongs to board (it feeds the board's staging file). It is a silent no-op until
# a repo declares _meta/intake-sources.json, so core board stays quiet by default.
# module
